routes.pageLayout: animated canvas hero + bilingual DATA sections + footer nav to /plans and /arena

routes.pageLayout: animated canvas hero + bilingual DATA sections (ideology, coalition, operational model, institutions, policies, synthesis, conclusion) + footer nav to /plans and /arena

notes.data_authority: src/data.js is the authoritative runtime dataset for sectors, connections and blueprint geometry and currently contains bilingual fields.
notes.suggested_content_dir: content/ at project root (content/pages, content/blueprints, content/sectors, content/images).

description.en: Long markdown string or array of sections

notes.localization: App supports EN + FA via src/locales. You requested English-only content; ensure content files are English and keep bilingual keys in src/data.js intact if present.
notes.consumption_in_ui: Blueprint viewer and other pages currently import BLUEPRINTS directly. To scale content editing, implement a content loader that maps content/blueprints/*.json into the runtime model or generate src/data.js from content files at build time.
